== 10% ==
A family of five are doing the Hokey Cokey. Grandma always gets it wrong and puts an arm in when everyone else puts a leg in and a leg in when everyone else puts an arm in. when the song says “you put your left leg in”, how many legs in total are not ‘in’?

Four people are doing it correctly so have one left in and one leg out but grandma has her arm in and both legs out. 4 + 2 = 6

== 1% ==
What two letters replace the question marks?

TE times T equals MESSAGE<br>TO times IN equals POISON<br>E times '''IT''' equals LEAVE

If you replace ‘times’ with ‘X’, you form words with the same meaning as the words on the right.
